subject: Proof-of-fit: scope, success metrics & access (Crestline)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@crestline.ai>, Aisha Khan <aisha@crestline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap — Proof-of-fit next steps

Hi Sam / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Peak inference latency spikes on your batch/interactive mix during end-of-day runs (95p sometimes > 1s) — product impact on UX.
- Cost variability on refresh pipelines; the team wants a runway to cut per-token costs at peak while keeping quality.
- Data governance requirement for PII masking and a desire to evaluate a private VPC-hosted option if needed.

Primary goals for the proof-of-fit
1) Reduce 95p tail latency to <200ms for preview workflow (interactive subset).
2) Demonstrate stable unit cost improvement (target: ~3x reduction at peak) with batching/quantization strategies.
3) Establish a reproducible prompt-set evaluation (10k prompts) with baseline quality metrics (top-1 accuracy / BLEU-like score).

Proposed next steps
- Redwood + Crestline kickoff: ops and infra access + initial prompt set delivery (we'll do a 2-week spike then 4-week eval).
- Redwood to provide access checklist and config for VPC/private-test if you want to try private deployment.
- Agree on owners & timeline (below I propose names).

Immediate asks from Crestline
- Share temporary S3 bucket/write credentials or a staging dataset link (CSV) for the prompt set.
- Confirm who owns procurement/legal signoff cadence.

Attachments referenced:
- initial prompt set (mup-prompt-set-v1.csv, stub)
- redwood quickstart & setup guide (redwood-setup-guide.md)

I'll compile a short kickoff charter today and propose specific dates. Please call out anything I missed.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Engagement Lead — Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Subject: Re: Discovery recap — Proof-of-fit next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick items from our side: 
- We can provision a staging S3 bucket by EOD Monday (I'll loop infra).
- Procurement / legal: small PO for trial is fine, our procurement lead needs standard SOC2 evidence before production — can you share a SOC2 summary?
- Timeline: a 2-week spike then 4-week evaluation sounds right; target kickoff next Tue if that's still good for you.

Per Jordan's note, here is the ops checklist I'll use to stand up the initial environment. Attaching the prompt set stub for convenience.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-09T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff — Crestline proof-of-fit (charter & milestones)

Sam / Aisha —

Following internal coordination, here's the kickoff charter and milestone plan. This is intended to be the single reference for the next 6 weeks. Please confirm owners and any timeline constraints.

Scope (what we'll test)
- Interactive preview workflow: measure 95p latency with KV cache and continuous batching enabled.
- Batch refresh job: measure throughput and per-token cost with quantized model variant.
- Quality regression checks: run the 10k prompt suite and track top-1 exact-match and a human spot-check sample.

Success metrics (pass/fail criteria)
- Latency: 95p for interactive preview <= 200ms during target load (defined as 50 concurrent interactive sessions).
- Cost: unit inference cost improvement of >= 2.5x vs your current baseline at equivalent throughput.
- Quality: no >5% drop in top-1 accuracy vs baseline on the core 2k production prompts; human review acceptable on edge cases.

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (Tue Sep 14 — Fri Sep 18): access provisioning, data handoff, and small smoke tests.
- Week 1–2 (Sep 21 — Oct 2): 2-week spike (Redwood deploys endpoint, initial tuning).
- Week 3–6 (Oct 5 — Oct 30): formal eval, prompt-set runs, quality checks, recommended config handover.

Access & setup steps (actionable)
1) Crestline: provide IAM user / S3 staging link by Mon Sep 13 (Ben will need write access).
2) Crestline: share any network constraints if you want private VPC testing (CIDR / peering window).
3) Redwood: provision temporary endpoint, share credentials and tracing hooks by Sep 16.
4) Crescent: (sic) we'll run an initial 2k prompt pass and share baseline numbers; Crestline to add production-like prompts into the csv by Sep 18.

Immediate asks (today)
- Sam: confirm procurement lead contact and whether a small PO can be approved before Sep 20.
- Aisha: confirm S3 staging timeline and whether you prefer pre-signed URLs vs an IAM user.

Attachments for this kickoff (stubs)
- mup-prompt-set-v1.csv — initial prompt set
- redwood-setup-guide.md — ops checklist & endpoint config

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/CRST-2026-0492
- Shared eval drive (will populate): https://docsend.redwood/reports/CRST-setup

If that looks good I will schedule a 30‑minute kickoff on Tue Sep 14 for the hands-on ops sync.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Engagement Lead — Redwood Inference
